// Ensure settings row exists, then update quiet hours await sql` INSERT INTO notification_settings ( notification_subject_template, notification_body_template, quiet_hours_start, quiet_hours_end, timezone, updated_at ) SELECT '{{product_name}} is back in stock!', '

Great news! {{item_detail}} is back in stock.

', ${safeStart}, ${safeEnd}, ${safeTz}, now() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification_settings) `; await sql` UPDATE notification_settings SET quiet_hours_start = ${safeStart}, quiet_hours_end = ${safeEnd}, timezone = ${safeTz}, updated_at = now() `;
